confusion: ❌ 'Dot product gives a vector' ✅ Dot product (scalar product) *always* results in a scalar quantity.
❌ 'Dot product of perpendicular vectors is max' ✅ The dot product of perpendicular vectors is *zero* (cos 90° = 0).
❌ 'A dot product can be calculated for vectors of different dimensions' ✅ Dot product is only defined for vectors of the same dimension.
